about_the_game:
Oceanic Rails is a game where you manage and expand your island. You will be transforming your small world into your own, with plants, animals and many structures. But you won’t do this alone, your helpers will be there by your side.

Explore the beautiful pixel art world and shape your island as you see fit. Each day, a new merchant train arrives with items ranging from new plants and upgrades to unique modifiers that create twists, new opportunities, and fresh strategies for you and your helpers. Modifiers like giant plants, useful totems, and headlamps for your helpers are just the tip of the iceberg.

Game Modes

Whether you want a relaxing, creative experience or a strategic challenge, Oceanic Rails has a mode for you.

Your Run

In this challenging mode, each week gets progressively harder and your helpers more expensive. Create powerful combos with the modifiers you acquire and prepare your strategy to survive the run. Be ready for difficult weather conditions that can strike at any time!

Trials

These short and sweet scenarios are quite challenging. Tackle trials with a specific beginning and end, each featuring unique modifiers, limitations, and rules. Can you conquer all the island's trials?

Your Island

No stress, no pressure. Enjoy building and decorating your island with your helpers in this sandbox mode. It contains everything found in the other game modes, but the rent and salaries are cheap. Plus, the weather is always nice on this island.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13, macOS 10.15, macOS 13.0
  • Processor: Apple M1+ or Intel Core 2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0
  • Processor: Apple M1+ or Intel Core 2
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support or Direct3D 11 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: x86_64 CPU with 4 physical cores or more or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full OpenGL 4.6 support
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Build, create and manage your island! Combine crops, animals and helpers with unique modifiers and upgrades. Play a farming rougelike, where each run has different possibilities, with challenging weather and week-end rent, or build you island worry free and create a beautiful pixel art world.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Latin America, Spanish - Spain
